_doc: Enforcement-parity ledger (ADR-034). Every audit finding must exit via one of: test | ci | guard | waiver. exit.type='open' entries age against severity SLAs (high=30d, medium=60d, low=90d from 'filed'). scripts/ledger_check.py fails CI on delinquent entries. Waivers require 'expires' and 'reason'; an expired waiver is delinquent. Do NOT close a finding by deleting it — set its exit and keep the row.

findings.summary: Unauthenticated POST /api/compass calls the Anthropic API with no rate limit — wallet-drain/abuse vector.

exit.ref: src/lib/ratelimit.ts wired into src/app/api/compass/route.ts (interim in-memory limiter)

findings.summary: Durable, cross-instance rate limiting + spend caps + LLM observability via Vercel AI Gateway (replaces RL-001 interim limiter; also covers /api/brief and /api/guide Claude calls).

exit.reason: Requires provisioning + configuring Vercel AI Gateway (dashboard + project env), an infra change not executable from a code PR. The RL-001 interim in-memory limiter (guard) remains in force on /api/compass in the meantime. Deferred with Zach's explicit sign-off (2026-09-26, echo-detector-seaworthy PR).

findings.summary: Trust contract §3 promises account deletion within 30 days but no implemented deletion path existed.
Trust contract §1 (anonymous sessions write nothing server-side) has no regression test — the exact defect disclosed in §1 could silently recur.

exit.reason: A faithful regression test needs a DB-introspecting integration harness; the repo has no unit/integration runner (only Playwright e2e), so wiring one is a test-infra + dependency decision beyond this PR (AGENTS.md: no new deps without asking). Proper close = a real test; convert exit.type to 'test' once the runner is chosen. Short expiry (high severity) forces revisit. Deferred with Zach's sign-off 2026-09-26.

findings.summary: src/lib/ygate.ts (core scoring algorithm, pure function) has zero unit tests.

exit.reason: The repo has no unit-test runner (only Playwright e2e); adding one is a dependency decision deferred (AGENTS.md: no new deps without asking). ygate.ts is a pure function and is a good first unit-test target once a runner lands — convert exit.type to 'test' then. Deferred with Zach's sign-off 2026-09-26 (echo-detector-seaworthy PR).

findings.summary: CI lint is advisory (continue-on-error); no lint rule prevents className/Tailwind recurrence after the 2026-07-11 removal.

exit.ref: scripts/no_tailwind_guard.py wired as a HARD step 'No-Tailwind guard (LINT-006)' in .github/workflows/ci.yml (smoke job). Fails CI on any Tailwind utility-class signature in a src/ className; proven fails-on-bad + passes-on-good. The advisory lint stays; this is the non-advisory guard for the Tailwind-recurrence class.

findings.summary: No exception tracking on the app (SageTrace exposure was detected via a vendor email, not our own alerting).

exit.reason: Requires standing up an error-tracking service (e.g. Sentry) + a DSN secret + app wiring — an infra/ops decision and a new dependency, not executable from a code PR. Deferred with Zach's sign-off 2026-09-26 (echo-detector-seaworthy PR).

findings.summary: DATABASE_URL manually set, rotation risk open since ADR-005 amendment (2026-05-28).

exit.reason: Requires Zach to rotate the Supabase password and re-sync Vercel envs — not executable by a session alone. Prior waiver lapsed 2026-08-15; renewed with a SHORT 30d window (high-severity security) to force the rotation, not to park it. Re-acknowledged by Zach 2026-09-26 (echo-detector-seaworthy PR).

findings.summary: Production DB backup restore has never been tested — an unrestored backup is a hope, not a backup.

exit.reason: A restore drill requires access to the Supabase production project and a staging target — an ops action not executable by a session/PR. Deferred with Zach's sign-off 2026-09-26 (echo-detector-seaworthy PR); should be scheduled as a real drill.

findings.summary: Trust contract §2 'aggregate anonymized only' modeling claim has no code boundary enforcing it (purpose limitation is prose-only).
Orphaned Supabase tables (meeting_cards/risks/raci/etc.) with no owning app; 4 advisor WARNs deliberately unfixed (backlog #13/#14).

exit.ref: Migrations drop_orphaned_prototype_tables + rls_deny_all_profileupload (2026-07-18): all 8 tables verified empty + zero code refs in arcs-v9/arcs-care, dropped with Zach's approval; ProfileUpload RLS ERROR (post-ADR-008 table, SageTrace defect class) fixed same pass. Advisor now 0 ERROR / 1 WARN.

findings.summary: Legacy arcs-care 'sessions' table has an anon INSERT policy (WITH CHECK true) — open write surface on an inactive product; last remaining advisor WARN. Decide: drop the legacy arcs-care tables (sessions/waitlist) or tighten the policy.

public/arcs_recoil_canvas.py + public/arcs_recoil_philosophy.md were served world-readable by filename on every arcs.care host (same exposure class as the 2026-07-24 war-room HTML move). canvas.py hardcoded real Fanatics counterpart names + private per-person assessments + recoil stop-loss/NCI method; philosophy.md is the internal Forensic Cartography method doctrine. The J24 leak_check only scanned public/*.html, so these non-HTML source/doc files slipped the gate.

exit.ref: Both files git-mv'd public/ -> runtime/recoil/ (unserved). scripts/leak_check.sh hardened with a stray-source gate that fails CI on any *.py/*.md directly under public/, closing the recurrence class.

findings.summary: Receipt Studio (/api/receipts/studio/[tenant]): the sessionId bearer now grants WRITE (PATCH close/score), not just READ, and travels in the GET query string (?sessionId=), so a Referer/proxy-log/history leak is a write capability. Accepted for the robin tenant (Zach's own demo receipts, non-attributable). CISO review finding B, 2026-08-07.

exit.reason: Blast radius is one non-sensitive demo tenant. MUST NOT generalize to a user-attributable/sensitive tenant without moving the token to a header/cookie or a POST body. Re-review before onboarding any such tenant.

findings.summary: In-memory per-instance throttle Map on the studio route (and its louisville precedent) is bounded only by instance lifetime x unique IPs — a rotating-IP scraper can grow it. SRE review finding F3, 2026-08-07.

exit.ref: Both anon routes now opportunistically evict expired entries when hits.size>5000: src/app/api/receipts/studio/[tenant]/route.ts and src/app/api/louisville/receipts/route.ts throttled(). Bounded.
